title: registry.tenant.settings_changed payload (v1)
description: Tenant settings changed (highValueThresholdUsd, highRiskCountries, retentionDays, demoMode). Ids and changed field names only; no secrets or password data. Producer: registry. Exchange: aegispulse.domain. FRs: FR-TEN-08. Describes only the envelope `payload` (PROJECT.md §6.4, §6.7); consumers ignore unknown fields (NFR-13).
